name: User-Defined ROI Refinement
definition: A technique where a user specifies a Region of Interest (ROI) in an initial image approximation to generate a more detailed view of that specific area by subdividing octree leaf nodes covering the ROI.
summary: User-Defined ROI Refinement is an interactive multiresolution volume rendering technique that dynamically subdivides octree nodes to enhance specific user-specified regions, balancing global performance with local detail.
